en: Illustrated advertising postcard for a steam brewery. It shows a bearded king-like figure in a red robe sitting on a beer barrel and holding up a foaming mug, scenes of brewery workers operating large vats and machinery, and a horse-drawn wagon loaded with beer barrels. Decorative hop vines frame the industrial scenery. The lower part contains printed German and Russian text naming the brewery and city.
